name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.descendRM_val
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν) (c : ν → Nat)
  (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)) (rls : List.{0} (List.{0} ν)) (y : ν),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.val (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.descendRM N c U rls y))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.descendR N U rls y)

source.code:
theorem descendRM_val (U : List (ν × ν)) : ∀ (rls : List (List ν)) (y : ν),
    (N.descendRM c U rls y).val = N.descendR U rls y
  | [], y => rfl
  | L :: rest, y => by
      simp only [descendRM, descendR, bind_val]
      rw [findM_val 1 _ (fun x => decide (N.ResL U x y)) (fun x => N.resM_val c U x y)]
      cases L.find? (fun x => decide (N.ResL U x y)) with
      | none => rfl
      | some x => simp [descendRM_val U rest x]

⊢ (N.descendRM c U (L :: rest) y).val = N.descendR U (L :: rest) y

ν : Type
inst✝ : DecidableEq ν
N : Network ν
c : ν → ℕ
U : List (ν × ν)
L : List ν
rest : List (List ν)
y : ν
⊢ (match (findM 1 (fun x => N.resM c U x y) L).val with
      | some x => do
        let p ← N.descendRM c U rest x
        Pure.pure (y :: p)
      | none => Pure.pure [y]).val =
    y ::
      match List.find? (fun x => decide (N.ResL U x y)) L with
      | some x => N.descendR U rest x
      | none => []
